captions_note: the panel sits above the head, the reel's captions keep running under it
in_a_reel: build it after the reel's cuts are final: it reads segments.json, words.json and plan.json from the project, so a later re-cut needs a new build
T_IN and T_OUT are words of a line about how the video was made; the whole move is about 1.4 s, and a longer gap between them only holds the finished panel
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (title_font, title_weight, ink) before the first build; no real editing app's logo or interface
steps: edit TITLE, T_IN and T_OUT in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the panel's place, the times and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
